videos.desc: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a man eases the cork out of a champagne bottle from an ice bucket; the cork pops into the sky, he fills a tray of flutes with fizzing champagne and the dressed-up friends toast and drink.
videos.said: Careful, hear it! To us tonight!

videos.desc: A couple pull a golden roast bird out of the oven; the man carves it at the counter, twists off a whole leg, lifts it by the bone onto a plate and then holds it up and bites the meat straight off it while the dog watches.
videos.said: Look at that gold! Hear it? Crispy!

videos.desc: At a night street-food table a bamboo steamer of pleated soup dumplings is opened; a woman demonstrates the chopstick grip and a man, eyes popping with delight, lifts one wobbling dumpling out of the basket and posts it whole into his mouth.
videos.said: like this pinch got it look

videos.desc: At a sunset beach bar a bartender pours juice, squeezes lime and adds ice into a shaker, shakes it and strains a layered orange-red drink into a tall glass. He garnishes the cocktail with pineapple, a cherry and a paper umbrella, and a couple sips it through straws.

In a candlelit kitchen a man twists a corkscrew into the cork of a wine bottle, folds the lever down and pulls the cork out with a pop, sniffs it, then pours red wine for himself and a woman and they toast.

Two runners in sportswear build a colorful healthy plate in a kitchen: spinach, oats, tomato slices, avocado, berries, eggs and nuts arranged in rings. They taste it, celebrate, and jog out the door with their packs.

A young woman in a grey beanie and red scarf bites into a fresh croissant outside a bakery, closes her eyes and savors it with a blissful face, saying "Oh wow". She then shares it with a friend on the bench, who tastes it and enjoys it just as much.

In an orchard, hands score the skin of a large red pomegranate with a knife, slice off its crown, and slowly pull the fruit open into flower-like segments packed with glistening red seeds, held above a crate of more pomegranates.

In a sunny garden a woman tastes a drop of vinegar from a small glass cruet and screws up her whole face at how sour it is, while her partner laughs. He then pours just a splash of it over their tomato salad and they toss it and eat happily.
videos.said: So sour! Wow! Just a splash.

videos.desc: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.

A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.

An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.
videos.said: One iced latte with oat milk. Ma'am, we only do fried chicken. No, sweetie. I said oat milk. The customer is always-- Fried pigeon, limited time.

videos.desc: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.

A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

A man in a neon vest fills a blender jug with banana slices, mango chunks, raspberries and spinach, blends it to a bright orange smoothie and pours it into a tall glass. He lifts the glass, takes a long drink and pulls it away with an orange smoothie moustache on his upper lip, grinning at how good it is.

Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

On a frozen lake under a low winter sun a man in an orange hooded parka cooks breakfast on a small portable gas stove. A single egg fries in a black pan; he lays strips of streaky bacon in beside it and they curl and brown. The shot widens to a large flat pan holding rows of bacon rashers around a heap of fried potato chunks and two fried eggs, which he lifts towards the camera, steaming in the cold air.

A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.

A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.

Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

A young man in a suit sits down to three very different meals in three countries. At a blue plastic table on a narrow southern street a pan of meatballs in tomato sauce lands in front of him; in a trattoria with red checked cloths a waiter lifts the lid of a steaming tagine of stew; at a rooftop restaurant above a night skyline a plated steak with vegetables is uncovered under a silver cloche. Each time his eyes go wide with amazement.

A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.

At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.

In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.
videos.said: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.

videos.desc: In a small shop with tall wooden shelves packed with jars of jam and tins, a brass lamp and a brass ladder, there is an empty gap in the middle of one shelf where the jars have run out, and a grey cat lies curled up in it. A hand in a rust knitted sleeve with a silver bracelet reaches up towards the gap. The cat wakes, yawns widely and settles down again, and the hand moves down to the jars on the shelf below. Small brown mosaic tiles cover the wall under the shelves.

In a bright old-fashioned ice-cream parlour with painted tiles and a glass chandelier, a young woman in a cream knitted jumper and a green skirt leans over a long glass counter full of trays of ice cream, including pistachio, fig, blood orange, lemon and chocolate, touching her cheek and pointing as she tries to choose. A young man in a brown shirt stands beside her, watches her and laughs. Behind the counter a young woman in a white shirt and navy apron waits and works.
